decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD is a low-cost catalog item that fits the strategy of broadening genres, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspiration the firm is unlikely to start problemistic search, so it keeps the item in stock.
The illustrated release series is a multi-model line that builds the label's curated identity, so the firm likely keeps carrying it as a distinctive offer while results stay satisfactory.
Reissued jazz vinyl sits at the core of the label's competence and benefited from the vinyl boom, so it plausibly meets aspirations and needs little slack to keep.
Limited multi-disc box sets often sell out and are not repressed, but as a catalog item it probably stays listed while stock remains, so dropping is somewhat likely but not the base case.

The compilation CD was only mentioned rather than featured, which suggests weak salience, and with the CD market declining it likely falls short of aspiration, so its shelf and warehouse resources are better shifted to stronger lines.
